The Tsaritsa agrees to sit for a new portrait at the urging of her retainers. But it seems that she has some concerns that may not be confined to the painter's easel alone...

#### Go to the Zapolyarny Palace

**Paimon:** Is the Tsaritsa going to... do some painting?

**Anastasya:** Ah, you're here.

- **Traveler:** Do I need to bow?

**Anastasya:** You may dispense with such formalities. They are meaningless.

**Anastasya:** One of my ministers suggested that I permit the public to create and collect portraits of me, so that the people might feel closer to me.

**Anastasya:** I'm amenable to the idea, but first, I need to have a portrait made to serve as a reference. So I wanted to ask what kind of portrait you think it should be...

**Paimon:** Uh...

- **Traveler:** You want us to decide?

**Anastasya:** This is a portrait that is destined for the homes of the people, not one to be kept in the palace for my own appreciation.

**Anastasya:** In other words, the version of me in this portrait will become who I am in the eyes of the populace.

**Paimon:** That makes sense. If it's gonna affect how everyone sees the Tsaritsa, we need to give it some careful thought...

**Anastasya:** I believe the best course of action is to seek answers from the populace itself.

**Anastasya:** Most people would want me to be a Tsaritsa who loves this country, yes? Then let them tell us what that kind of Tsaritsa should look like.

**Paimon:** So you want us to gather their opinions.

**Anastasya:** You could say that, but not in the form of a public survey or a questionnaire.

**Paimon:** Oh, why...?

**Chayka:** Distributing questionnaires will inevitably alert administrative bodies at all levels. If that happens, we will no longer be able to control who comes to claim them.

**Chayka:** In that case, Her Majesty would most likely just end up with another report from the Snezhnograd Veche instead of who she truly wants to hear from.

- **Traveler:** I'm guessing... You want me to approach this from my own perspective then.

**Anastasya:** Precisely.

- **Traveler:** Leave it to me.

**Paimon:** Huh, but without a questionnaire, how are we supposed to gather people's opinions? Snezhnaya is huge! It's not like we can go door to door!

**Chayka:** You could always start with your own connections. Perhaps pose the question to a friend.

**Paimon:** Good idea! The Tsaritsa did say she wanted us to take a personal approach.

**Paimon:** Hm, let's think... Why don't we start with Alyosha and the others. Then, we can ask Sandrone and that whole bunch.

**Chayka:** If you've decided who to ask, I can draft a couple of letters on your behalf, asking them to submit the kind of portrait they envision.

**Chayka:** I imagine they will either need to purchase art supplies or commission an artist. Of course, we cannot let your friends bear this expense, so I will arrange the funding.

**Chayka:** Once the portraits are ready, all you need to do is collect them, and then Her Majesty can decide which one is most suitable.

**Paimon:** Wow, you've thought of everything...

- **Traveler:** What kind of portrait do you envision, Chayka?

**Chayka:** ...Me?

**Paimon:** Of course! You said to ask our friends, right? Even though we haven't known each other long, we still think of you as a friend!

**Chayka:** Hearing you say that makes me... Ahem, I'm not sure I can answer that question on my own. I'll write a letter and ask everyone back home.

**Paimon:** Sounds like a plan!

In the blink of an eye, two days go by.

#### Go to the Korolevskiy Troupe

**Alyosha:** Well hello there, special envoy.

**Paimon:** Geez! You just came out of nowhere...

**Vodyanitsa:** Gotta say, I was pretty surprised by your letter, you two! A member of the Rokot serving as the Tsaritsa's special envoy?

**Alyosha:** It's not that surprising. I mean, we already have a Fatuus working with us.

**Vodyanitsa:** True... But, news this important? Why didn't you tell us sooner? What does a special envoy to the Tsaritsa do? I'm not letting you go until you explain.

- **Traveler:** Maybe some other time...

**Odette:** Vodyanitsa, let's get down to business first. I'm sure Traveler has to report back soon.

**Vodyanitsa:** Fine... I do think what the Tsaritsa should look like in the eyes of the people is an important question.

**Vodyanitsa:** So, we commissioned an artist to turn our ideas into a portrait. Take a look, special envoy.

**Paimon:** Wow...

**Artist:** Allow me to share the creative concept behind this painting.

**Artist:** For the background, I went in with a natural setting, with plants and flowers that I drew from memory. I was going for spring in bloom.

**Artist:** Then, I placed Her Majesty sitting elegantly among the flowers, which I think is a perfect fit for the theme you all provided. I hereby present, "The Tsaritsa in Spring"!

**Paimon:** The Tsaritsa... In Spring!?

**Vodyanitsa:** It was Alyosha's idea. It's really fun, don't you think? The Tsaritsa looks beautiful like this, doesn't she?

**Alyosha:** Plus, I thought if people put it in their homes, it could really warm the place up, y'know.

**Odette:** Perhaps it's more of a reckless interpretation, but I think it's worth presenting to Her Majesty.

- **Traveler:** We'll pass it on.

**Paimon:** If you say so, Traveler.

**Vodyanitsa:** You better tell me all about how you became a special envoy sometime, okay?

**Alyosha:** Snezhnaya is covered in snow, even during the spring, so we commissioned an artist from Fontaine to bring our vision to life. We didn't even use all the funds... Guess I'll give the rest to the Rokot.

**Odette:** I appreciate you passing on our idea to the Tsaritsa.

**Artist:** The quintessentially wintry Tsaritsa, in spring... Quite a challenging premise.

#### Go to Torchlight Books

**Paimon:** Hey, Sandrone! Hey, Arlecchino!

**The Rooster:** Well look who we have here. The special envoy and his companion. / Well look who we have here. The special envoy and her companion.

**Paimon:** Huh? What are the rest of them doing here?

**Marionette:** I happened to route the payment for the artist through the Northland Bank, and it was noticed immediately. Are you obsessively tracking every single Mora in Snezhnaya, Pantalone?

**Regrator:** Merely doing my duty, Miss Sandrone.

**The Rooster:** I am aware that myself and Pantalone involving ourselves was not something you anticipated, special envoy.

**The Rooster:** But Her Majesty the Tsaritsa's image is a matter of great importance. As her loyal subjects, Pantalone and I feel obliged to do our part in this endeavor as well.

**Marionette:** Hmph...

**The Knave:** In short, after some discussion, we decided to come up with an idea together.

- **Traveler:** Let's see it.

**The Rooster:** Behold.

**Paimon:** Oh, wow. She looks so... cold. Or, um, serious?

**The Rooster:** In our hearts, Her Majesty the Tsaritsa should embody both of those elements.

**The Rooster:** Her cold and imposing nature is helpful for deterring factions with ill intent, ensuring lasting peace and stability for Snezhnaya.

**Regrator:** Not to mention, this painting is of exceptional quality. If Her Majesty were to reserve distribution rights to the state, she could earn a substantial sum of Mora from the printing sector.

**Regrator:** It would certainly help replenish the state treasury. We have quite a lot of expenses these days.

**Marionette:** Ignore him. He's just spouting nonsense as usual. As for Pulcinella's assessment... I'm mostly in agreement.

**The Knave:** Indeed. Given Snezhaya's present circumstances, I do believe our leader needs a more intimidating image.

**Paimon:** Alright... We'll pass it on.

**The Rooster:** What is weighing on Her Majesty this time?

**Regrator:** I do hope you'll convey my thoughts on replenishing the national treasury to the Tsaritsa.

**Marionette:** If you need anything in the future, just come find me in person.

**The Knave:** Congratulations on becoming Her Majesty's special envoy. She deserves to have someone like you by her side.

#### Check out the portrait prepared by Chayka

**Paimon:** Hey, Chayka! Is your portrait all ready?

**Chayka:** Uh... Well...

**Paimon:** Wow, it's so... cute! Is Paimon allowed to say that about the Tsaritsa?

**Chayka:** After the Belyi Tsar passed away, the Tsaritsa became the one to guide us.

**Chayka:** Although she's always seemed somewhat aloof and unapproachable, everyone still wants to feel closer to her. That's probably why it feels so natural to depict her in our own image...

**Chayka:** I'm just worried I've overstepped...

- **Traveler:** No, no. I think it's a great idea.

**Paimon:** Yeah! The Tsaritsa wanted a variety of opinions, anyway. Let's show it to her.

**Chayka:** Alright.

**Anastasya:** Hmm...

**Paimon:** Wonder which one the Tsaritsa is gonna choose...

- **Traveler:** I know. I'm so curious...

**Anastasya:** As a hunter, your friend must travel through the towns of Snezhnaya quite often. I assume he represents the opinions of most villagers.

**Anastasya:** Pulcinella is deeply entrenched government affairs. Most of the time, his opinions can be said to represent those of the entire administrative system.

**Anastasya:** As for Chayka's interpretation... I imagine quite a few fae in Snezhnaya share the same view.

- **Traveler:** So which one do you think is the most fitting?

**Anastasya:** ...Chayka. Relay my command.

**Anastasya:** The portrait submitted by the Harbingers shall be hung in the hall of Glupov.

**Anastasya:** "The Tsaritsa in Spring" shall be displayed in the theater of the Korolevskiy Troupe.

**Anastasya:** As for the portrait you submitted, Chayka... Hm, let us hang it in the streets of Zapolyarny. Fae often frequent that area for relaxation and leisure, if I recall.

**Chayka:** Hm? Oh, Y—Yes, Your Majesty.

**Paimon:** Wait, you're picking all three...?

**Anastasya:** These portraits have helped me realize that, although Snezhnaya has but one Tsaritsa, each of my people sees me differently.

**Anastasya:** I shall not force them to regard me in a certain manner. The version of the Tsaritsa they wish to see is the version they deserve to behold.

**Anastasya:** These three portraits can all be used as reference for the people to create paintings of their own. Let their imagination be the only limit to what they create.

**Paimon:** Wait, so that means... You're gonna let people paint you however they want?

**Anastasya:** It is only natural for the populace to have different expectations of their sovereign. A worthy ruler should strive to live up to all of them, no?

**Anastasya:** In practice, such a thing is often impossible. But when it comes to these portraits, at least, no side need be disappointed.

**Paimon:** What if someone has you standing on the back of a polar bear, riding into battle?

**Anastasya:** Hah... That paints an interesting picture indeed. Who's to say I haven't longed to do just that?

**Paimon:** What!?

**Anastasya:** What other expectations do people have of me, I wonder...?

**Chayka:** Thank you, Your Majesty...
